# A dataset with all output variables generated by the BLN package

This table contains all soil indicators and soil quality scores for the
BLN package

## Usage

``` r
bln_output_description
```

## Format

An object of class `data.table` (inherits from `data.frame`) with 49
rows and 2 columns.

## Details

- code:

  The name of the output parameter

- parameter:

  A description of the output parameter
